_readme: EXAMPLE. Copy to ocr-overrides.json. Fields that OCR cannot currently read reliably. Each entry supplies the human/visual value and WHY OCR fails, so the pipeline can fill the gap honestly (never a guessed OCR value) and it can be revisited later. Keyed by <PERSON>/<DOCUMENT>/<field>.
_howToUse: ocr-passports.mjs (and other OCR scripts) consult this file: if a field is null after OCR and an override exists, the override value is used and the transcript records _source as 'override (visual, OCR blocked)'.

DOE-JOHN/PASSPORT/issue.reason: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY. Describe here why OCR could not read the field (e.g. the issue-date digits are overprinted on the label text and overlap it), so the manual value is recorded honestly rather than guessed.
DOE-JOHN/PASSPORT/issue.confirmedBy: visual read, cross-checked against the expiry on the same row
DOE-JOHN/PASSPORT/issue.revisit: Try: (a) higher-resolution rescan, (b) hue-specific channel math to separate ink from label, (c) a different OCR engine tolerant of overlapping glyphs.
